-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.CCModel` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def CCData : Option CCMsg → List w8 → Prop :=
  match x✝¹, x✝ with
  | none, bs => bs = []
  | some (CCMsg.v1 m), bs => ccDecodeV1 bs = some m
  | some (CCMsg.v2 m), bs => ccDecodeV2 bs = some m

def instDecidableIsConfEnt (e : EntryM) : Decidable (IsConfEnt e) :=
  id inferInstance

theorem propConfStep_length {joint : Bool} (applied li : w64) (acc : List EntryM × w64) (x : EntryM
    × Option CCMsg) : (propConfStep joint applied li acc x).fst.length = acc.fst.length + 1

structure CCV2M : Type where
  transition : raftpb.ConfChangeTransition
  changes : List ConfChangeSingleM
  context : List w8

theorem cctypes_mem {ents : List EntryM} {cs : List (Option CCMsg)} (H : CCTypesOk ents cs) (x :
    EntryM × Option CCMsg) : x ∈ ents.zip cs → x.snd.isSome = true → IsConfEnt x.fst

def ccWantsLeave : CCMsg → Bool :=
  match x✝ with
  | CCMsg.v1 a => false
  | CCMsg.v2 m => m.changes.isEmpty

theorem propConf_foldl_repl {joint : Bool} (applied li : w64) (xs : List (EntryM × Option CCMsg))
    (Hxs : ∀ (x : EntryM × Option CCMsg), x ∈ xs → x.snd.isSome = true → IsConfEnt x.fst) (pre :
    List EntryM) (acc : List EntryM × w64) : PropRepl pre acc.fst → PropRepl (pre ++ List.map
    Prod.fst xs) (List.foldl (propConfStep joint applied li) acc xs).fst

def ccEntryType : Option CCMsg → raftpb.EntryType :=
  match x✝ with
  | some (CCMsg.v1 a) => W32 1
  | x => W32 2

def propConf (applied li pci : w64) (ents : List EntryM) (cs : List (Option CCMsg)) (joint : Bool :=
    false) : List EntryM × w64 :=
  List.foldl (propConfStep joint applied li) ([], pci) (ents.zip cs)

theorem foldl_propConfStep_length {joint : Bool} (applied li : w64) (xs : List (EntryM × Option
    CCMsg)) (acc : List EntryM × w64) : (List.foldl (propConfStep joint applied li) acc
    xs).fst.length = acc.fst.length + xs.length

theorem propConf_take_succ (joint : Bool) (applied li pci : w64) (es : List EntryM) (cs : List
    (Option CCMsg)) (k : Nat) (e : EntryM) (o : Option CCMsg) (He : es[k]? = some e) (Ho : cs[k]? =
    some o) : propConf applied li pci (List.take (k + 1) es) (List.take (k + 1) cs) joint =
    propConfStep joint applied li (propConf applied li pci (List.take k es) (List.take k cs) joint)
    (e, o)

def IsConfEnt (e : EntryM) : Prop :=
  e.Type' = W32 1 ∨ e.Type' = W32 2

theorem propConf_take_zero {joint : Bool} (applied li pci : w64) (es : List EntryM) (cs : List
    (Option CCMsg)) : propConf applied li pci (List.take 0 es) (List.take 0 cs) joint = ([], pci)

inductive CCMsg : Type
  | CCMsg.v1 : CCV1M → CCMsg
  | CCMsg.v2 : CCV2M → CCMsg

structure CCV1M : Type where
  type : raftpb.ConfChangeType
  nodeId : w64
  context : List w8
  id : w64

theorem PropRepl.refl (es : List EntryM) : PropRepl es es

def PropRepl (es es' : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  List.Forall₂ (fun e e' => e' = e ∨ IsConfEnt e ∧ e' = zero_val EntryM) es es'

theorem PropRepl.length {es es' : List EntryM} (H : PropRepl es es') : es'.length = es.length

def CCTypesOk (ents : List EntryM) (cs : List (Option CCMsg)) : Prop :=
  List.Forall₂ (fun e o => o.isSome = decide (IsConfEnt e)) ents cs

theorem propConf_length {joint : Bool} (applied li pci : w64) (es : List EntryM) (cs : List (Option
    CCMsg)) : (propConf applied li pci es cs joint).fst.length = min es.length cs.length

def propConfStep (joint : Bool) (applied li : w64) (acc : List EntryM × w64) (x : EntryM × Option
    CCMsg) : List EntryM × w64 :=
  match x.snd with
  | none => (acc.fst ++ [x.fst], acc.snd)
  | some c =>
    if uint.Z applied < uint.Z acc.snd ∨ ccWantsLeave c ≠ joint then (acc.fst ++ [zero_val EntryM], acc.snd)
    else (acc.fst ++ [x.fst], li + W64 ↑acc.fst.length + W64 1)

def CCDecodes (ty : w32) (bs : List w8) : Prop :=
  (ty = W32 1 → ∃ m, ccDecodeV1 bs = some m) ∧ (ty = W32 2 → ∃ m, ccDecodeV2 bs = some m)

def (sealed) ccDecodeV2 : List w8 → Option CCV2M

def (sealed) ccDecodeV1 : List w8 → Option CCV1M

theorem propConf_repl {joint : Bool} (applied li pci : w64) (ents : List EntryM) (cs : List (Option
    CCMsg)) (H : CCTypesOk ents cs) : PropRepl ents (propConf applied li pci ents cs joint).fst

theorem forall₂_app.{u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {R : α → β → Prop} {a1 a2 : List α} {b1
    b2 : List β} (H1 : List.Forall₂ R a1 b1) (H2 : List.Forall₂ R a2 b2) : List.Forall₂ R (a1 ++ a2)
    (b1 ++ b2)

def enterJointOf (t : w32) (n : Nat) : Option (Bool × Bool) :=
  if t ≠ W32 0 ∨ 1 < n then
    if t = W32 0 ∨ t = W32 1 then some (true, true) else if t = W32 2 then some (false, true) else none
  else some (false, false)
